{{Short description|Norwegian educationalist}}

'''Svein Erlend Sjøberg''' (born 22 May 1943) is a Norwegian physicist and educationalist, born in [[Oslo]]. He is among the central developers of [[Didactic method|didactic methods in natural sciences]] in Norway.

Following his [[cand.real.]] degree with a master's thesis in physics at the [[University of Oslo]] in 1970, he also took an MA in education at the [[University of Leeds]] in 1975.<ref name=snl>{{cite encyclopedia|year=|title=Svein Sjøberg|encyclopedia=[[Store norske leksikon]]|editor=|publisher=|location=|url=http://www.snl.no/Svein_Sjøberg|language=no|access-date=10 December 2023}}</ref>

Following his attainment of the [[dr.philos.]] degree in 1982, he became an [[associate professor]] at the University of Oslo in 1985 and professor in 1993. He is known for textbooks in natural sciences for all levels of primary and secondary education, and for ''Naturfagenes didaktikk. Fra vitenskap til skolefag'' (1990, second edition 1992) and ''Naturfag som allmenndannelse'' (1998, third edition 2009).<ref name=snl/>

Sjøberg also participated in the public debate on [[education policy]].
He won the University of Oslo's [[science communication]] prize in 2013.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.uniforum.uio.no/nyheter/2013/08/kolleger-skjonner-ikke-at-jeg-vager.html|title=– Kolleger skjønner ikke at jeg våger|author=Lindqvist, Helene|date=21 August 2013|work=Uniforum|language=no|access-date=10 December 2023}}</ref>

Sjøberg was inducted into the [[Norwegian Academy of Technological Sciences]] in 2005 and the [[Norwegian Academy of Science and Letters]] in 2009.<ref name=snl/>
